title: A Hymn for the Portrait
author: Hazel Kavanagh
blurb: Juniper Fairweather, a property surveyor appraising a house that appraises back, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. But when the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must return what was taken in 1974, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
